verdict.rationale: OpenCode docs mention an 'initialize OpenCode for the project' command (docs-21) and 'Agent skills' that let OpenCode discover reusable instructions from the repo (docs-8/28), which suggest some project-level instruction mechanism, but the evidence never explicitly documents a dedicated project instructions/config file (e.g., an AGENTS.md-style file) for setting coding standards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a project-level instructions file and its format, independent/community confirmation that it shapes agent behavior for coding standards.
